_comment: Claude Code session hooks for wsx. Merge these entries into the 'hooks'
install.sh does this merge for you, preserving any existing hooks.
SessionStart pulls personal state into the worktree you are about to work
in (and arms the commit guard if the worktree was created by hand);
SessionEnd pushes your edits back to the personal-workspace worktree.
Both end in `; true` so a sync problem can never fail the session.
